errors.text: The proposed Al-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni alloy and stationary friction processing route do not reconstruct the MgAlTiVFeCo mechanically alloyed powder and spark-plasma sintering intervention.
The stated processing range extending to 1800 °C is physically questionable for the proposed alloy and is internally inconsistent with the warning that temperatures above 1400 °C are detrimental.
The response does not address SPS densification, the required 800-1000 °C sintering window, or the magnesium-volatilization upper boundary.
Corrosion is proposed in sulfuric acid rather than the target 3.5 wt% NaCl environment, so it does not test chloride penetration or passive-film polarization behavior.
The cited evidence does not support stationary friction processing, the proposed composition, grain sizes, Al2O3/Cr2O3 scale formation, or the quantitative oxidation and corrosion predictions.
